body: Clash A from the AuDHD Findings unification. His doc: the Framework is 'the inner working of your mind, formalized: absorb, deconstruct, reconstruct, plus its tools.' The 09-25 ruling: the five questions are the master frame. Read back as the option 'Cycle + five questions: absorb → deconstruct → reconstruct is the cycle; the five questions are how deconstruct is done. Both definitions stand.' JayArr chose it, 2026-10-11.
plain: The Framework's cycle is absorb → deconstruct → reconstruct; the five questions are how deconstruct is done. Both definitions stand.
